contentTypes.name: Listing
contentTypes.description: A physical place or point of interest on the island. One back-end content type holds many different kinds of places because every one of them appears on the interactive map. Displaying them on the map makes the shared group feel natural to visitors and keeps them manageable as one set behind the scenes.

contentTypes.name: Event
contentTypes.description: A dated happening on the island, from tours and performances to festivals and community gatherings.

contentTypes.name: Blog
contentTypes.description: Editorial content: announcements, stories, itineraries, visitor information, and event recaps.

contentTypes.name: Property
contentTypes.description: Leasable buildings and spaces, supporting the real estate and leasing side of the site.

contentTypes.name: Permit
contentTypes.description: Permitted uses of the island: rentals, filming, events in public space.

taxonomies.name: Listing Type
taxonomies.visibility: Filter on multiple pages. Also used behind the scenes to pull content into dynamic modules.

taxonomies.name: Blog Type
taxonomies.description: Content type or format for blog posts.
taxonomies.notes: Terms should not overlap with Focus.

taxonomies.name: Focus
taxonomies.description: Broad focus, aligning with the content pillars plus history.
taxonomies.visibility: Filter on multiple pages. Also used behind the scenes to pull content into dynamic modules.

taxonomies.name: Amenities
taxonomies.description: Practical amenities that would not warrant their own listing page, but that users would want to know about a location.

taxonomies.name: Dietary Preferences
taxonomies.description: Only applied to food and drink listings.
taxonomies.visibility: Filter on the Food & Drink page.
taxonomies.notes: Scoped to Food & Drink listings only.

taxonomies.name: Region/Area
taxonomies.description: Useful for return visitors who know regions, and aligns people to wayfinding signs on the island.
taxonomies.notes: Should not lean on this too heavily; most visitors do not know these reference points.

taxonomies.name: Status
taxonomies.description: Optional status for things like public art. Allows coming-soon pieces to appear on the website before they open.
taxonomies.notes: Not the same as the automatic open-now indicator, which is computed from hours and season data.

taxonomies.name: Cost
taxonomies.notes: Not the same as the custom text field for price details.

taxonomies.name: Season
taxonomies.notes: Might end up being a custom field instead of a taxonomy.

taxonomies.name: Tenant Disciplines
taxonomies.description: For filtering tenants and businesses only.
taxonomies.visibility: Only visible on the tenant/business page as a filter.

taxonomies.name: Climate Challenges
taxonomies.description: For filtering climate pilot programs only.
taxonomies.visibility: Only visible on the Climate Pilot page as a filter.

taxonomies.name: Property Size
taxonomies.visibility: Only visible on the Properties page as a filter.
